about.title: Who I am
about.subtitle: About me
about.text1: Hi, I am a Fullstack Developer passionate about building intuitive, high-performance, and scalable web applications. My journey into development started with a curiosity about how technology can simplify and improve everyday life.
about.text2: I love the problem-solving aspect of programming, where logic meets creativity. Turning complex technical challenges into elegant solutions is what drives me.
about.text3: I thrive in collaborative environments, where I can share knowledge, learn from others, and contribute to meaningful projects. Being adaptable, I work effectively both on-site and remotely.
about.text4: For me, programming is not just about writing code. It is about creating useful digital experiences that help people and businesses work better.

skills.title: Skill Set
skills.description: My projects combine frontend implementation, fullstack architecture, API integration, authentication, databases, and automation. I focus on building clear, maintainable products that solve practical user problems.
skills.contact_link: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding my knowledge.

project2.title: Weather App
project2.description: Helps users quickly check current weather, forecast, and accurate local time for any city, including timezone and daylight-saving handling. Built with React, API integration, geolocation, unit switching, and resilient user feedback.
project2.skills: API integration, Geolocation, Timezone handling, Unit switching, Responsive UI, Error handling
project2.technologies: React, Tailwind CSS, OpenWeather API, Luxon, React Toastify, GeoNames API

project3.title: Nutrient App
project3.description: Solves the everyday problem of understanding meals and nutrition by letting users search foods, track nutrients, and plan meals with real nutritional data. Built as a React SPA with routing, Bootstrap UI, API data, and local persistence.
project3.skills: Food search, Nutrition tracking, Weekly meal planning, Client-side persistence, Responsive UI
project3.technologies: React, React Router, React Bootstrap, USDA FoodData API, LocalStorage

project4.title: Mehr Blog
project4.description: Gives authors a complete publishing flow: sign in, manage a profile, upload images, and create, edit, or delete posts through a documented REST API. Built with a React frontend, Node/Express backend, MongoDB, JWT auth, and cloud deployment.
project4.skills: User authentication, CRUD posts, File upload, Profile editing, REST API, Swagger documentation
project4.technologies: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Swagger, Vercel, Render

project5.title: Talki Chat App
project5.description: Solves real-time communication needs with private and group chats, secure authentication, file sharing, read receipts, reactions, and theme support. Built with a React frontend, Node/Express API, MongoDB, Socket.IO, JWT, and Multer.
project5.skills: Real-time communication, Group and private chats, File uploads, Read receipts, Emoji reactions, Authentication
project5.technologies: React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO, JWT, Multer

project6.title: Meal Plan Generator
project6.description: Helps users turn dietary preferences and restrictions into personalized meal plans, with account management and payment-ready product flow. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Clerk, Stripe, React Query, and OpenAI API.
project6.skills: AI recommendations, Authentication, Payments, Database modeling, Server-state management
project6.technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, Clerk, Stripe, OpenAI API, Prisma, React Query

project7.title: Enterprise Admin Dashboard
project7.description: Shows how a business admin interface can organize KPIs, statistics, protected pages, and navigation in a maintainable frontend architecture. Built with React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, React Router, Axios, SCSS Modules, and a demo auth flow.
project7.skills: Feature-oriented architecture, Protected routes, Demo auth flow, Redux async states, Responsive dashboard UI, Reusable components
project7.technologies: React, Vite, TypeScript, React Router, Redux Toolkit, React Redux, Axios, SCSS Modules, ESLint, Prettier
